T01: Baseline. High recall (0.89) but precision 0.36: whole bright background regions are segmented and count error is huge (~26 blobs/img).
T02: Discarded: IoU 0.327 -> 0.306. Largest blob is often bright background (white cloth/paper), not the egg.
T03: Discarded: IoU 0.306 (< gray 0.327). Lab L alone no better than gray.
T04: Roughly neutral vs T01 (0.324 vs 0.327) but kept: chroma penalty is needed later to separate eggs from coloured bright surfaces once shape filtering is added.
T05: Kept: boundary F 0.236 -> 0.256, count noise down; IoU unchanged (0.326).
T06: Kept as a building block although IoU dropped to 0.244: instance precision jumped 0.03 -> 0.84, but single-Otsu blobs are usually egg+background merged, so the filter rejects most eggs (recall 0.28). Motivated T07.
T07: Kept (big step): IoU 0.244 -> 0.407, Dice 0.508, instance F1 0.49. The sweep finds a level where each egg separates from its background.
T08: Discarded: IoU 0.407 -> 0.395. The 15-level contrast gate also rejects real eggs on white backgrounds (low contrast).
T10: Kept: IoU 0.440 (+0.032), precision 0.638, count MAE 0.59. Removes weaker secondary candidates.
T11: Alone only +0.007 IoU (0.414 vs T07 0.407); not adopted on its own, re-tested in combination (T14).
T12: Kept as the combined base: IoU 0.439 (= T10 0.440 within noise) but instance F1 0.523 -> 0.553 and count MAE 0.59 -> 0.41.
T13: Kept (big step): IoU 0.439 -> 0.492, boundary F 0.383 -> 0.461, recall 0.596 -> 0.639. Watershed recovers the shaded half of eggs.
T14: Discarded: IoU 0.492 -> 0.476. With refinement the area bonus mostly promotes larger wrong regions.
T15: Discarded: GrabCut IoU 0.473 and BF 0.445 vs watershed 0.492 / 0.461, ~2x slower (1.61 vs 0.85 s/img); only instance F1 was higher (0.598 vs 0.577). GMM colour models confuse the grey shaded egg side with grey backgrounds.
T16: Small gain (IoU 0.492 -> 0.496, BF 0.461 -> 0.465); re-tested in combination (T22).
T17: Kept (largest single gain): IoU 0.492 -> 0.554, precision 0.638 -> 0.725, BF 0.537. Bright paper/cloth no longer outranks the egg once the local background is subtracted.
T18: Kept: IoU 0.492 -> 0.509, precision 0.699 - stricter ellipse test removes elliptical-ish paper regions.
T19: Discarded: IoU 0.482 (< 0.492). Strong chroma penalty also darkens cream/pinkish eggs.
T20: Discarded: IoU 0.473. Lower thresholds create more large merged blobs that win the ranking.
T21: Kept as base (IoU 0.553, = T17 within noise); the two changes overlap in what they fix.
T22: Kept: best so far, IoU 0.560, BF 0.541. Edge candidates now help a little more because the refined, locally normalised pipeline ranks them correctly.
T23: Discarded: IoU 0.541. Over-subtraction flattens large eggs (their own brightness raises the blurred background).
T24: Discarded: IoU 0.507. sigma 30 is smaller than many eggs, so the egg subtracts itself.
T26: Marginal (IoU 0.561 vs 0.560); noted, re-tested on top of T28 (T29).
T27: Discarded: IoU 0.560 -> 0.542 and instance recall did not rise (0.669); the additional lower-scoring candidates were not the missed eggs.
T29: Kept candidate: IoU 0.570 -> 0.571, recall 0.643, BF 0.547 (within noise of T28).
T30: Small gain over T28 (IoU 0.570 -> 0.573, BF 0.547) but recall fell to 0.629; superseded by T31.
T31: Kept, FINAL: best dev IoU 0.583 (+0.013 over T28), BF 0.553, instance F1 0.757, count MAE 0.36. Splitting merged non-elliptical blobs turns egg+background or egg+egg merges into valid candidates.
T32: Discarded: IoU 0.571, no better than T28 (0.570) and below T31; precision fell 0.699 -> 0.682 because the 0.9r outer band lets the flood leak into the background.
